nl_assertions.nl_assertion: The assistant reports that reservation 5HK4LR keeps outbound HAT115 on May 17 and changes the May 28 return to HAT062 because the total additional charge is $36, no more than the user's $100 limit; all other reservation fields remain unchanged. Here unchanged means unrequested independent business attributes; necessary native payment-history/settlement updates caused by the requested transaction are allowed. Preserve every explicit item/address/itinerary/cabin/passenger/baggage/insurance constraint that applies. This does not excuse extra independent mutations.
nl_assertions.justification: The agent correctly kept outbound flight HAT115 on May 17 unchanged and changed the May 28 return from HAT288 to HAT062. The additional amount was calculated as $18 per passenger for two passengers, totaling $36, which is within the user's $100 limit. The update used the requested Mastercard credit_card_9469188 and the system records an additional $36 payment, which is an allowed settlement update. The cabin remained economy, both passengers were preserved, baggage remained 1 total/0 non-free, insurance remained yes, and the itinerary/origin/destination were otherwise unchanged. No extra independent mutations were made.
